# subscription-stripe

> Generated by `scripts/docs-generate.ts` from `modules/subscription-stripe/registry-item.json` and its skill. Do not edit this file. Run `pnpm docs:generate` to update it.

A subscription provider on Stripe through stripe and @better-auth/stripe; needs a Stripe account.

## Install

```saasaloy-command task=add name=subscription-stripe
saasaloy add subscription-stripe
saasaloy env
pnpm install
```

1. Run `saasaloy add subscription-stripe --dry-run` to print the plan and write nothing. Check the files it writes and the modules it adds first.
2. Run `saasaloy add subscription-stripe --yes` to write the files.
3. Run `saasaloy env` to fill the environment values the new modules declare. With no terminal, pass each value as `--set KEY=VALUE`.
4. Run `pnpm install` to fetch the new dependencies.
5. This module ships no skill. Read the `subscription` skill under [What your agent reads](subscription.md#what-your-agent-reads) and follow it to use the module in your code.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Services | Optional | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | api | required when `SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=stripe` | Your Stripe secret key (sk_test_… while you develop, sk_live_… in production). Required once SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=stripe. The client is built on first use, so a project that keeps SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=console runs the whole capability — sign-in included — with this unset; the throw then names the key on the first call that reaches Stripe. |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | api | required when `SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=stripe` | Required while SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=stripe, and may stay blank under any other provider. The signing secret of the endpoint you registered at https://dashboard.stripe.com/webhooks, pointing at https://<your-api>/auth/stripe/webhook. The plugin verifies every delivery against it, so an unsigned POST is refused before any handler runs. |
